span.p:
approve, edit and reject are accepted in any state: the last event wins.
Every approve passes the same override check (choice) first.
comment changes nothing but the comments. approved, edited and rejected
count as resolved, export needs every claim resolved (or a preview).
Every event carries prev_hash and hash (SHA-256): verify_chain()
finds a changed history, and export is then blocked.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Evidence: rejected readings dropped, a corrected value replaces the
model's, unconfirmed ones get the verifier flag image_unconfirmed.
Map measurements made in code need no confirmation.

svg.text: Code · state machines: a claim under review (review.session) and an image reading (imaging.confirm)
